name: The Lower Reaches
desc: Floors 1 to 3: the Old Toll Level, the Flooded Stair and the Silk Gallery. Each floor must be cleared before the next opens.

name: The Wilds
desc: Floors 4 to 6: the Greenwood, the Mire and the Warren. A goblin war band holds the wilds above the Lower Reaches; its warchief waits at the bottom of the Warren.

name: The City
desc: Floors 7 to 10: a city whose castle is the band’s hub, and its four wards, south, west, north and east. Gate: the Key to the City prestige boon. The wards open together and may be cleared in any order; each one cleared raises the level of every monster in the wards by +2, then +5, then +9.

name: The Harbor
desc: Floors 11 to 14, the harbor band. Pick a side at the harbor on floor 11 (merchants, pirates, privateers or the navy; one per run), sail its convoys on floors 11 to 13 for crates, and finish its mission on floor 14.

name: The Vermin Festival
desc: Floors 15 and 16, the Vermin Festival: ten rooms of ten, one survivor from each, then one of a hundred. The festival keeps its own clock, which runs only while the game does; time away inside it goes to banked bonus time.
